Name: Outer Titan Worldbreaker
Information:
**Worldbreaker**

The ultimate form of Outer Titan, which only one of exists at a given time. The worldbreaker resides within the Luminal Graveyard, waiting for a tesseract to open a gate that can allow it to emerge into the Material Plane where it acts as the avatar of Luminal Minus. Its presence has, without fail, resulted in the death of any planet or civilization it encounters. If not stopped, the presence of a worldbreaker drains a planet of its eidolic energy and distorts its remaining life, hollowing it out until the titanic beast unleashes enough energy to devastate small planets and mortally wound large ones.

**Worldbreaker vs Heavenbreaker.** When it is said that Setanta engages in a perpetual battle with Luminal Minus, it is this beast that is most commonly being referred to. Setanta and his Spear Hounds engage in a nearly ceaseless battle with the worldbreaker, keeping it weak, and pushing it back into the Luminal Graveyard when they must. However, Luminal Minus has found ways to subvert their efforts (even if only briefly) when a chance to deploy the beast arises—something it does only when the consumption of a planet is assured. It is often seen as Setanta’s counterpart, a reflection of his impossible, eternal struggle to protect the cosmos.

**Replacement Cells.** If killed, Luminal Minus will delay its efforts to consume planets for a time, and instead deploy a tesseract that has been outfitted with a “cosmic titan cell” to be planted in the heart of a planet rich in eidolic radiation, or within a star. That cell will be nourished by the energy around it for the next century, then a new worldbreaker will emerge from the planet while devastating it from the inside. As time has passed, it has become apparent to the Spear Hounds that Luminal Minus has planted several of these cells around the galaxy preemptively, though they will not begin to grow while the current worldbreaker lives. Due to this, the Spear Hounds and Setanta will avoid killing the existing worldbreaker unless they know for certain the existing cells are accounted for or destroyed.

Stat Blocks.title: Outer Titan Worldbreaker

traits.name: Sunset of a Civilization (Mythic Awakening)
traits.description: When the titan would be reduced to 0 hit points or killed outright, it instead is reset to 600 hit points, recovers from any ongoing effects currently causing it to be restrained, grappled, paralyzed, or take ongoing damage at the start or end of its turns, regains its Legendary Reactions, and can use its Mythic Actions for 1 hour. If a group manages to defeat the titan within 1 hour after activating Sunset of a Civilization, they are awarded an additional 155,000 XP (310,000 XP total).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The titan makes two Claw attacks, then uses its Annihilation Burst or its Bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Macro Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 120 ft., one target. Hit: 34 (4d12 + 8) piercing damage plus 33 (6d10) radiant damage (macro: 56 piercing damage plus 60 radiant damage).

actions.name: Annihilation Burst
actions.description: The titan chooses one point it can see within 1,000 feet where a burst of energy erupts in a 50-foot-radius sphere. Each creature in that space must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw (macro), taking 14 (3d8) force damage and 14 (3d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one (macro: 24 force damage plus 24 radiant damage).

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Macro Melee Weapon Attack: +17 to hit, reach 80 ft., one target. Hit: 41 (5d12 + 8) slashing damage (macro: 68 slashing damage).

actions.name: Mythic Action: Luminal Eradicant Sphere (1/Rest)
actions.description:
The titan creates an interplanar gate within its body (to the Luminal Graveyard), producing energy from Luminal Minus that congregates into a huge sphere of devastation. It can use this orb in one of two ways: to target up to six points it can see within 5,000 feet, where a 100-foot-radius sphere expands from each, or it may target a single point it can see within 3-km, where a 1-km-radius sphere erupts. This sphere of destruction causes an expansive wave of gravity, which then collapses back in on itself like a black hole. Each target within range must succeed a DC 27 Dexterity saving throw (macro), taking 65 (10d12) force damage plus 65 (10d12) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful save. Creatures who fail by 5 points or more are stunned until the end of the titan’s next turn (macro: 120 force plus 120 radiant).

Structures and the landscape within twice the sphere’s range are also targeted and take double damage from this effect. Targets reduced to 0 hit points by this effect are erased from existence, leaving no trace except artifacts and eidolic items if they are Titanic or smaller.

Each target within range with a CR or level of 10 or lower automatically fails their saving throw as though they had rolled a d20 result of 1.

legendary_actions.name: Space Swimmer
legendary_actions.description: The titan moves up to its movement speed.

legendary_actions.name: Depth Cry (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.description: The titan generates a layered wave of thunderous sound, forcing each creature within 120 feet of it to make a DC 27 Constitution saving throw (macro), taking 22 (4d10) thunder damage and being knocked prone on a failed save (macro: 40 thunder damage).

legendary_actions.name: Devour (Costs 3 Actions)
legendary_actions.description:
The titan makes a grapple attempt against one Titanic or smaller creature within range of its Bite. If it succeeds, the target is swallowed by the titan. While swallowed, the target is restrained and compressed by a gravity well inside its body, cannot use movement to leave the body, and takes 22 (4d10) force damage at the start of each of their turns. Creatures swallowed this way can bypass the titan’s Damage Threshold, and if the titan takes more than 40 damage from a creature inside it over one turn, it must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn with a DC equal to half the damage it took. On a failure, it regurgitates all creatures it has swallowed, who exist in a space within 50 feet of the titan, prone.

Creatures who are Huge or smaller are not restrained while inside the titan’s body, and are still able to move within it. Creatures contained within a vehicle or other enclosure are not damaged as long as whatever is enclosing them takes the damage for them.

A creature who succeeds against the titan’s grapple cannot be swallowed this way for 24 hours.

Stat Blocks.mythic_actions_intro: The creature may use the following actions as Legendary Actions for 1 hour after using their Mythic Awakening.

mythic_actions.name: Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
mythic_actions.description: The titan makes a Bite attack against a target within range.

mythic_actions.name: Astral Decay Rain (Costs 3 Actions)
mythic_actions.description: Each target the titan chooses within 10,000 feet is treated as though targeted by its Annihilation Burst action.

legendary_reactions.source_conversion_note: Converted from Legendary Resistance (3/Day) per standing formatting rule.
